spans.s: बिभित्सा [bibhitsā], A wish to break through, a desire to pierce or penetrate.
बिभित्सु [bibhitsu], a. Desirous of piercing or penetrating.

A means of terrifying, terror. -णः N. of a demon and brother of Rāvaṇa. [Though a demon by birth, he was extremely sorry for the abduction of Sītā by Rāvaṇa, and severely reprimanded him for his wicked act. He several times advised Rāvaṇa to restore Sītā to Rāma if he cared to live; but the proud demon turned a deaf ear to his warnings. At last seeing that the ruin of his brother was inevitable, he repaired to Rāma and became his staunch friend. After the death of Rāvaṇa, Rāma installed him on the throne of Laṅkā. He is believed to be one of the seven Chirajīvins; see चिरजीविन्.]
That which threatens or scares away; यदि ते सन्ति सन्त्वेव केयमन्या बिभीषिका
बिभ्रज्जिषु [bibhrajjiṣu], a. Wishing to fry. -षुः Fire; रुषा बिभ्रज्जिषु- प्रख्यं कपिं बाणैरवाकिरत्
Disgusting, loathsome. nauseous, hideous, revolting; हन्त बीभत्समेवाग्रे वर्तते
'Oh ! it is indeed a loathsome sight'.
Loathing, detesting; बीभत्सु- रतिबीभत्सं कर्मेदमकरोत् कथम्
The disgusting sentiment, one of the 8 or 9 rasas in poetry; जुगुप्सास्थायिभावस्तु बीभत्सः कथ्यते रसः S.
N. of Arjuna. -त्सा Loathing, abhorrence. -त्सम् Anything loathsome.
Reserved, coy (said of a woman); सा बीभत्सुर्गर्भरसा निविद्धा
. -त्सुः an epithet of Arjuna; (Mb. thus explains the word: न कुर्यां कर्म बीभत्सं युध्यमानः कथंचन । तेन देवमनुष्येषु बीभत्सुरिति विश्रुतः ॥); तृट्परितः परिशान्तो बीभत्सुर्यमुनामगात्
